version.description: Schema version of the workflow definition. Determines which blueprint class the runner uses to execute the workflow.

name.description: Unique identifier name for the workflow

vars.description: Workflow-level variables available for {variable} interpolation in step prompts

defaults.description: Default values inherited by all steps unless overridden

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute in the workflow

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks that run before or after tool calls

pre_tool.description: Hook functions to run before each tool call

post_tool.description: Hook functions to run after each tool call

id.description: Unique identifier for this step, referenced by other steps

prompt.description: Instruction prompt for the agent. Supports {variable} interpolation from workflow vars.
examples: Fetch all open tickets in epic {epic} using JIRA

load_project.description: Path to a project root from which to load the full project configuration. Loads .claude/settings.json (passed to SDK as settings path), reads CLAUDE.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md as references (appended to system prompt), scans .claude/agents/*.md as agent definitions, and registers shell command hooks as 'project_pre_tool'/'project_post_tool'. Sets cwd to the project path for subsequent prompt steps. Supports {variable} interpolation.

allowed_tools.description: Whitelist of tools the agent may call during this step

foreach.description: Template expression resolving to an iterable. The step runs once per item. Use {{ steps.<id>.output.<field> }} syntax.

condition.description: Jinja2 expression that must evaluate truthy for this step to run. Access prior step results via steps.<id>.success (bool) or steps.<id>.message (list). Use the 'contains' filter to search messages for a substring, or 'json_value' to parse message strings as JSON and extract a value by dot-path.

action.description: What to do when the step fails

notify.description: Hook function to call on failure
